title: The Unsampled Truth: Quantifying Prompt Artifacts in LM Psychometrics
abstract: arXiv:2606.03357v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When prompting language models for psychometric assessment, researchers assume that the responses reflect the injected persona and the meaning of the survey item. We test this premise using a diagnostic design that crosses five semantically distinct baseline personas with five semantically equivalent variants of each of four prompt components (persona wording, task instruction, item wording, option symbol). Measuring the 1-Wasserstein distance between the resulting response distributions and partitioning the variation among the five components allows for the separation of target effects from prompt artifacts. We apply the framework to 13 open-weight small language models (0.6B to 14B) on the Big Five Inventory and the Short Dark Triad. translated_title: 未采样的真相：量化语言模型心理测量学中的提示伪影
translated_abstract: 当通过提示让语言模型进行心理测量评估时，研究者假设模型的响应反映了所注入的人设以及调查题项本身的含义。我们通过一种诊断性设计来检验这一前提：将五个语义上不同的人设与四个提示组件（人设措辞、任务指令、题项措辞、选项符号）各自的五个语义等价变体进行交叉组合。通过测量所得响应分布之间的1-Wasserstein距离，并在五个组件之间对变异进行划分，可以将目标效应与提示伪影分离开来。我们将该框架应用于13个开源权重的小型语言模型（参数量0.6B至14B），在大五人格量表和短版黑暗三联征量表上进行测试。我们发现，在大多数模型中，任务指令和选项符号对响应分布造成的偏移，大于对人设描述或题项本身进行同义改写所造成的影响。对于相当一部分（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种诊断框架，通过将人设与四个提示组件的语义等价变体交叉组合并测量响应分布间的Wasserstein距离，成功将心理测量中的目标效应与提示伪影分离，并发现任务指令和选项符号对响应分布的干扰比人设或题项措辞的改变更大。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diagnostic framework that separates target effects from prompt artifacts in LM psychometrics by crossing personas with semantically equivalent variants of four prompt components and measuring Wasserstein distances between response distributions, finding that task instructions and option symbols displace responses more than persona or item paraphrasing in most models.
